Fast crossprod for LazyMatrix (dense case)

lazy_crossprod_vec.Rd

Fast crossprod for LazyMatrix (dense case)

Usage

lazy_crossprod_vec(x, s, c, y)

Arguments

x

Dense matrix

s

Column scale inverse vector (1 / col_scales)

c

Column location vector (col_locations)

y

Vector to multiply

Value

Vector result of t(X_tilde) * y
